scope: Single SMILES-Morgan predictor; no PureGIN/PTDF/Top6 training
cma_definition: Residual cross-attention configuration, including pooled unimodal residual features and changed regression input dimension
rscl_definition: Continuous-RT ranking ratio SupCR: cross-view alignment + similarity + fusion loss
concat_rscl_extension: Train-only projection of concat(smiles_pooled,morgan_pooled); both SupCR terms retained; no change to regression forward path
selection: Validation MAE only; Yeo-Johnson fitted on train only; test evaluated after selection; no test-based hyperparameter or checkpoint choice
resume: Completed-epoch optimizer/scheduler/RNG resume; RDKit seeded by epoch; no bitwise-equivalence claim across devices/versions
historical_comparison: Training plans are defined by the experiment matrix and task index; plan all specifies twelve training jobs.
representation: Same ID subset without RT-based selection; independent t-SNE panel fits; quantitative original-space metrics required
